==Subspecies==
There are two subspecies recognized under ''T. securigera''.
*[[Tritonia securigera subsp. securigera|''Tritonia securigera'' subsp. ''securigera'']]
*[[Tritonia securigera subsp. watermeyeri|''Tritonia securigera'' subsp. ''watermeyeri'']]
